item.title: Incarico post-doc: Incarico Post-Doc - CEAR-09/A - Fare città. Tutela e trasformazione in FVG per una cultura del progetto (Univ. TRIESTE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-04 23:59
Institution: Univ. TRIESTE, Trieste
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-09 Progettazione architettonica

The research focuses on the critical study of the recent architectural heritage of Trieste and Friuli Venezia Giulia through the work of the Celli-Tognon architectural practice (1970s–early 1980s), with particular attention to collective housing, multi-family residential buildings, public space and urban form. Activities include the survey of 40–50 works, archival research, digitisation, critical cataloguing, interpretative redrawing, and typological, morphological and urban analysis, supported by national and international comparative studies. See the call for more details.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: OPEN HOUSING. Aggregable systems, participatory processes and local supply chains for a new season of public housing (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-27 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-08 Design, tecnologia dell'architettura, architettura tecnica e gestione dell'ambiente costruito

**The research aims** to develop tools and processes that support the design and construction of open, combinable, lightweight-technology housing prototypes. These prototypes are expected to reconcile flexibility and adaptability of spaces over time, the combinability of modules into different configurations, the sustainability of materials and construction systems, the accessibility of domestic and collective spaces, and the generation of local economic and employment benefits through a construction supply chain involving small businesses and vocational training pathways.

The Federico II University Penitentiary Center at the Secondigliano P. Mandato Penitentiary Center was founded in 2017 and opened in the first academic year (2018-2019). The over 100 students are divided into two sections: the high-security "Ionio" and the medium-security "Mediterraneo." item.title: Incarico post-doc: Advanced methods for masonry structural analysis and metamaterial design (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-06 Scienza delle costruzioni

The project is structured into two research lines. The first concerns the analysis of masonry structures and aims to develop models and algorithms for safety assessment, with particular attention to thrusting systems such as arches, vaults and arch bridges, using methods based on limit analysis. The load-bearing capacity of the structures, the effects of support settlements and collapse mechanisms will be examined. The second line focuses on the study of metamaterials through the design of units and lattices with programmable nonlinear responses, aimed at developing bistable, multistable or high-performance structures. In particular, metamaterials inspired by tensegrity and origami…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: 2026-IpdDip-03-DICAR- Advanced numerical modelling in geotechnical engineering for the assessment and mitigation of risks posed by natural hazards to structures and infrastructure (Univ. PAVIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-11 12:00
Institution: Univ. PAVIA, Pavia
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-05 Geotecnica

The research programme is aimed at the development and application of advanced numerical modelling methodologies in geotechnical engineering for assessing the safety and resilience of structures and infrastructure exposed to natural hazards, with particular reference to seismic and hydrogeological hazards. The activity will include the definition and calibration of numerical and digital models, the simulation of the effects induced by natural events, and the analysis of risk mitigation strategies. The effectiveness of mitigation measures and the interactions between soil, structures and infrastructure will also be assessed through selected case studies. The activities are part of Action 2…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Graphic representation strategies for the simultaneous and comparative analysis of architectural drawings in the S/D/R Archive of the Department of History, Drawing and Restoration of Architecture, Sapienza University of Rome (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-11 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-10 Disegno

This research aligns with contemporary strategies for engaging with the Sapienza archives dedicated to architectural drawing education; it involves systematizing knowledge of Rome’s built heritage, selecting diverse datasets, and managing and standardizing the processes of data acquisition and archiving. The project aims to develop methods and tools for the multidimensional exploration, interpretation, and analysis of archival data. This will foster interactive, dynamic engagement with the drawings and encourage new lines of inquiry tailored to diverse audiences, thereby enhancing the tangible and intangible assets of the Roman School’s tradition.
